description: Defines a template class 'modular_ch_est_list' for managing lists of channel estimates with views to each channel, including methods for resizing, setting channels, and retrieving channel data, within a wireless communication context.

classes.name: modular_ch_est_list
classes.description: A template class implementing a list of channel estimates with views to each channel, supporting resizing, setting, and retrieving channel data.

methods.name: modular_ch_est_list
methods.description: Default constructor creating an empty list.

methods.name: modular_ch_est_list
methods.description: Constructor initializing the list with specified number of resource elements, receive ports, and layers.

methods.name: set_channel
methods.description: Sets the channel view for a specific receive port and layer.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the list of channel estimates, with assertions to ensure limits.

methods.name: get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the channel data view for a given receive port and layer.

methods.name: get_nof_re
methods.description: Returns the number of resource elements.

methods.name: get_nof_rx_ports
methods.description: Returns the number of receive ports.

methods.name: get_nof_tx_layers
methods.description: Returns the number of transmit layers.
